brief: The unsexy truth about making your first $1M as a solo founder with AI. Quiet leverage, recurring revenue, business that prints money while you sleep. Lessons on pricing, niching, saying no to vanity metrics.

slots.subtitle: The unsexy truth about recurring revenue, AI leverage, and businesses that print money while you sleep.
slots.preview1: Why recurring revenue beats viral launches every time
slots.preview2: The pricing psychology that tripled my margins overnight
slots.preview3: How AI handles delivery while I handle strategy

slots.title: Quiet leverage
slots.subtitle: Speed without systems is just a hectic job wearing a founder costume.
slots.insight1Body: Productize services into templates customers deploy without your daily presence.
slots.insight2Body: Let models handle delivery while you architect pricing and positioning.
slots.insight3Body: Track profit divided by time invested, not gross revenue or headcount.
slots.pullQuote: I stopped selling hours and started selling outcomes at ten times the margin.

slots.title: Price for
slots.subtitle: Most founders undercharge because they price by comparison, not transformation delivered.
slots.insight1Body: Premium pricing signals confidence and filters out high-maintenance customers automatically.
slots.insight2Body: Offer yearly billing at two months free to guarantee cash flow today.
slots.insight3Body: Remove time-based tiers; customers buy outcomes, not your calendar slots.
slots.pullQuote: When I tripled my price, conversion barely budged but churn vanished overnight.

slots.title: Own the
slots.subtitle: Broad markets breed invisible products; narrow pain points create monopoly pricing power.
slots.insight1Body: Target urgent workflow bottlenecks instead of demographic stereotypes.
slots.insight2Body: One industry, one use case, one outcome repeated until you dominate.
slots.insight3Body: Every feature request outside your niche is a tax on focus.
slots.pullQuote: I serve one job title in one city and my calendar is full at premium rates.

slots.title: Ignore the
slots.subtitle: Followers and funding headlines do not fund your life; net profit and retention do.
slots.insight1Body: Gross revenue without margin context is just a vanity press release.
slots.insight2Body: Likes and impressions feel good but rarely correlate with signed contracts.
slots.insight3Body: Measure how much you earn while disconnected from tools and notifications.
slots.pullQuote: I deleted my dashboard and only checked profit and retention once a week.

slots.title: Recurring
slots.subtitle: One-time sales build a job; subscriptions build an asset that compounds while you rest.
slots.insight1Body: Embed your tool inside a workflow customers repeat daily or weekly.
slots.insight2Body: Remove friction from billing; the best renewal is one the customer never notices.
slots.insight3Body: Grow accounts through usage tiers, not new features you must build.
slots.pullQuote: My MRR graph became my heartbeat; every month it climbs without my intervention.

slots.title: Sleep well,
slots.subtitle: Leverage is not headcount; it is code, content, and capital working while you are absent.
slots.insight1Body: Train prompts and automations that resolve tickets before you wake.
slots.insight2Body: One essay or video compounds into inbound leads for years without editing.
slots.insight3Body: Annual prepay turns tomorrow's revenue into today's deployable capital.
slots.pullQuote: I woke up to more profit than my old salary and had not touched my laptop.

slots.ctaBody: Recurring revenue, premium pricing, and AI leverage are the unsexy engines behind every quiet million.
